The bug is in `ext_type`: `EXTRA_EXTS` has multi-line formatting, so extensions at the end of a line (like `aac`) are followed by `\n` not a space, causing the `case " $e "` pattern to fail.

_**Agent (copilot/claude-sonnet-4.6)**_

The `EXTRA_EXTS` string has extensions at the end of lines followed by `\n` instead of a space, so the `*" aac "*` case pattern never matched. The fix normalizes the string to a single space-separated line before matching — this also fixes all other end-of-line extensions (`mks`, `awb`, `spx`, etc.).
